parallels.note: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

translations.web: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
translations.bsb: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
translations.kjv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
translations.asv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
